steps.title: Welcome, Mayor
steps.text:
This town is yours to grow. You don't command heroes:
• [b]Build[/b] and paint zones
• Post [b]bounties[/b] and set laws
• Townsfolk and heroes choose for themselves
Follow the [b]gold outline[/b]. End the tour any time.

steps.title: Start the clock
steps.text:
Time runs in real time; pause whenever you like.
• [b]Space[/b] or a speed button: run or pause
• [b]+[/b] / [b]−[/b]: faster or slower
• Big news stops the clock (Settings)

steps.title: Look around
steps.text:
• [b]Scroll[/b]: zoom
• [b]Drag[/b], [b]WASD[/b] or the screen edge: pan
• [b]Q[/b] / [b]E[/b]: turn the view (try it)
• [b]Home[/b] or double right-click: back to the square

steps.title: Paint homes and shops
steps.text:
You don't place houses: you paint zones, and townsfolk build what they can afford.
• [b]Build[/b] or [b]B[/b]: the build bar
• Paint [b]homes[/b] for settlers, [b]shops[/b] for trade
• [b][[/b] / [b]][/b] or Shift+wheel: brush size
• The first tavern draws heroes
• Government buildings: click to place, drag to turn

steps.title: Charter goals
steps.text:
The card by the rail lists your [b]charter goals[/b].
• Click a goal to go straight to it
• [b]Next[/b] (N) by Build: whatever needs you, one click each
• Each pays a small reward
• The next goal takes its place

steps.title: Meet the townsfolk
steps.text:
Click anyone in the street, or any building, to inspect it.
• Names in the Ledger and news are links too
• Everyone has a character sheet
• Their everyday moments are real [b]d20[/b] rolls, over their heads

steps.title: The town at a glance
steps.text:
The top bar: households, heroes, treasury, food, [b]Mandate[/b], unrest, homes.
• [b]+212/mo[/b]: where it's heading this month
• Red outline: heading for trouble
• [b]Hover[/b]: the month in full
• [b]Click[/b]: the window that fixes it

steps.title: Gold words
steps.text:
Gold words like Mandate are keywords.
• [b]Hover[/b] one: a card explains it
• [b]Click[/b] it: pin the card (drag by its title)
• The book top right, or [b]F1[/b]: the whole glossary
Try one in this card.

steps.title: Every window, one click
steps.text:
Six groups on the left rail, each a window with tabs.
• [b]Badge[/b]: red urgent, gold a decision
• [b]Shift[/b]+1 to 6: a group
• Click a heading to fold it
Open [b]Town[/b], then the [b]Ledger[/b] tab: everything that happens in town.

steps.title: You, the mayor
steps.text:
You have a character sheet like any hero.
• [b]Mayor[/b] or [b]C[/b]: what needs you now
• [b]Character sheet[/b]: your rolled abilities and skills
• Your background is what you're good at in stories

steps.title: Heroes for hire
steps.text:
Adventurers have come. They drink, train and wait for work.
• Click one for their sheet
• Reward, knight, grant a fief or name a champion
• Loyal heroes stay when times turn dark

steps.title: Post a bounty
steps.text:
Heroes go where gold leads them.
• [b]Bounties[/b], or the [b]bounty board[/b] on the right tray
• Post a reward on a site in the wilds
• A company takes it when they think they can win
• Only council-paid bounties lift the fog

steps.title: Send explorers
steps.text:
The map only shows what someone has told the town.
• [b]Explore[/b] over the corner map: drag to paint ground
• The council pays a company to walk it until it's seen
• They report each lair, settlement and ruin first
• Right-drag rubs paint out

steps.title: The council
steps.text:
Three councillors bring [b]motions[/b] to sign or veto.
• Set [b]taxes[/b] and the watch
• Call a [b]festival[/b] to lift spirits
• Mandate fades to the middle unless earned
• Council, events and war are also on the right tray

steps.title: Alerts
steps.text:
Badges on the left rail need you.
• Red urgent, gold a decision; the number counts them
• [b]Hover[/b] a button: what waits there
• [b]Click[/b] one: go and answer it
• [b]Right-click[/b]: dismiss
They clear once solved.

steps.title: From thorp to great city
steps.text:
[b]City[/b] shows your charter and what the next one asks:
• Households, institutions, sometimes walls, gold
• Claim it when all is ticked
• New buildings and better houses open up

steps.title: Ready the walls
steps.text:
Something will come for your town. [b]Defence[/b] holds the guard and walls:
• Palisade and watchtowers first
• Stone walls, gatehouse, moat, barracks later
• Raiders strike when heroes are away

steps.title: Post the guard
steps.text:
You give the watch orders, not steps.
• [b]G[/b] (or [b]Plant[/b] in [b]Defence[/b]): click to plant a flag
• The nearest guards stand watch there
• Raiders shy from what it covers
• Click a flag to stand it down
Try one by your farms.

steps.title: Gods and factions
steps.text:
[b]Faith[/b]: the town's gods and factions.
• Build a temple for a god's favour
• Back a faction with gold
• Or crack down on one against you

steps.title: The long road
steps.text:
[b]Campaign[/b] tracks the saga:
• The acts
• Menaces that fester if left alone
• The big bad
[b]Chronicles[/b] keeps your heroes' tales.

steps.title: The campaign map
steps.text:
[b]M[/b] or [b]Campaign map[/b]: the land as an inked map.
• Drop markers to plan
• Drag to move them
• [b]Delete[/b] removes the one under the cursor

steps.title: Saving
steps.text:
[b]Esc[/b] or [b]Menu[/b]: save or load.
• Autosave every 7 days and on quit
• [b]F5[/b] quicksave, [b]F9[/b] quickload
• [b]History[/b]: the world before your town

steps.title: The town is yours
steps.text: That's the tour. From here, tips come one at a time when they matter: the first raid, the first story, the first guild. Good luck, Mayor.

steps.title: The weather
steps.text:
The sky by the clock shows the weather now.
• Hover it for the days ahead
• Storms, snow and mud slow parties, airships and marches
• The Ledger tells of the signs before a storm
• The cloud button by the map shows the weather layer

steps.title: Repairs
steps.text:
Storms, fires and raids damage buildings.
• Click a damaged one to choose how the town mends
• Builders: as they come to it
• First: ahead of new builds
• Hire: the council pays hands, for gold a day

steps.title: First contact
steps.text:
Whoever the town meets shows up:
• Foes under [b]War[/b], once someone has seen, heard of or fought them
• Powers and peoples under [b]Diplomacy[/b]
• Scouts, scrying, parties and witnesses find the rest

steps.title: What the explorers found
steps.text:
Explorers have sent word and wait for yours.
• [b]Investigate further[/b]: a chapter at a time, hours and a d20 each
• Risk if it goes wrong, more learned if right
• Or go in, deal with it, explore on, or come home
No answer: their leader decides.

steps.title: Eyes on the wilds
steps.text:
A party out of town is lost in the fog. From [b]Bounties[/b]:
• Commission a scrying
• Post scouts or hide mirrors at a site
• Send word, or call them home
Later the Scrying Pool and Sleepless Spire see further.

steps.title: Word from the road
steps.text:
A party with a caster or sending stone can ask you how to go on. The game pauses until you answer.
• Each choice: your d20 + your sheet + the party's best help
• Some quests take several sendings
• An [b]Adventurers' Hall[/b] adds to every roll and sends more often

steps.title: Bounty terms
steps.text:
A bounty says how, not just where. Terms at the top of the [b]Bounty board[/b]:
• [b]Slay[/b]: cleared for good
• [b]Drive off[/b]: quicker, cheaper, comes back sooner
• [b]Talk down[/b]: bargain with clever foes
• [b]Fetch[/b]: steal the hoard's best
Heroes judge the terms you post.

steps.title: Step into a story
steps.text:
A card pops up when something happens you can step into.
• Each choice is a [b]d20[/b] roll of your skill against a DC
• [b]Odds[/b] bar: green and full is near-certain
• [b]Reward[/b] / [b]Risk[/b]: what it could win or cost
• [b]Later[/b] leaves it in [b]Events[/b]; left alone it runs its course
• Tick [b]Inspiration[/b] to reroll a failure

steps.title: Heroes judge your choices
steps.text:
Every hero has a temper: merciful, ruthless, pious, mercenary, lawful, free-spirited or bold.
• Each choice shows who it [b]pleases[/b] or [b]angers[/b]
• That moves their loyalty (see it on the hero)
• Trust: they ask for help with a personal quest
• Anger: they bring a grievance

steps.title: Companies for hire
steps.text:
Other companies roam the wilds too. [b]Companies[/b]:
• Roster: power, loyalty, missions, deeds (click a column to sort)
• Offer a job by name: they march or say why not
• Buy their reports to map ground cheaply

steps.title: Taxes and unrest
steps.text:
Every household, hall and institution adds to service costs, so a village's rate won't pay for a city.
• Short: [b]unrest[/b] climbs, moods and Mandate slip
• At worst workers down tools and march
• Raise [b]taxes[/b] in [b]Council[/b] a point at a time
• Or earn more: trade routes, wonders, institutions

steps.title: Quick orders
steps.text:
Four buttons over the corner map:
• [b]Defend[/b]: horn on the gate and the threatened side (red while bare)
• [b]Guard[/b]: a guard flag, like [b]G[/b]
• [b]Strike[/b]: known threats, with a bounty or sellswords
• [b]Explore[/b] / [b]Patrol[/b]: paint ground to walk or keep

steps.title: Builders and homes
steps.text:
Each builders' yard adds three crews: more goes up at once.
• Build one (Government) when sites queue
• Homes grow a storey with a tavern, shrine, market, varied food and something pleasant near
• Click a house to see what it waits for

steps.title: See the town at a glance
steps.text:
[b]L[/b] or [b]Lens[/b] greys the town and colours one thing:
• [b]Room[/b]: space left on painted land
• [b]Work[/b]: idle homes and places hiring
• [b]Growth[/b]: houses ready to grow
• [b]Appeal[/b] and [b]Danger[/b]
Hover a building for why.

steps.title: Sow your fields
steps.text:
Farmland is sown one crop at a time, a brush each:
• [b]Wheat[/b]: bread
• [b]Root crops[/b]: winter food
• [b]Barley & hops[/b]: ale
• [b]Orchards[/b]: fruit and cider
• Pasture, herbs, vines with later charters
Each button says if the town wants more.

steps.title: Dress the town
steps.text:
[b]Decor[/b] on the build bar: trees, benches, lamps, fountains, statues.
• Click to place, drag to aim, [b]R[/b] or Shift+wheel turns
• Hold [b]Shift[/b] to place several
• Drag fences into rows; clear for half back
• Each helps a little: rest, watch, trade, favour
• Pleasant streets grow houses sooner

steps.title: Building sites
steps.text:
Click a building site to see its progress.
• [b]Put this site first[/b]: builders and materials go there first
• Every site takes timber and stone from the market
• Out of stock: builders stand idle (an alert says so)
• Fix: a lumber camp or quarry, or a dear but quick caravan

steps.title: Timber and stone
steps.text:
Every home, shop and farm is built from the town's own timber and stone.
• Out of stock: settlers' sites stand idle and new ones wait
• Settlers send away for it only after days, at a steep price
• Zone industry: a lumber camp and a quarry keep the town growing

steps.title: Raiders sighted
steps.text:
Farmers, scouts and friends report enemies on the move.
• Red mark: where seen, heading; it fades as it goes stale
• A band heading for a farm strikes tonight: plant a flag ([b]G[/b])
• A site's [b]Habit[/b] shows how its lair behaves
• [b]Campaign[/b]: every enemy leader and their grudge

steps.title: A stranger in the crowd
steps.text:
Someone doesn't belong: an enemy's agent, eyeing what to burn or knife tonight.
• Click the alert to go there
• Find the [b]hooded figure[/b] in the crowd
• Click them: the watch seizes them
Leave them and the watch must stop the blow.

steps.title: Call to arms
steps.text:
A host is marching on one side.
• Click the alert or that wall, press [b]Call to arms[/b]
• The nearest watch run up onto it
• Any wall, tower or gate can be called
• More guards than its share holds better; manned towers shoot

steps.title: Watch the siege
steps.text:
A host camps through the night and storms at dawn.
• The siege banner at the top follows each wave: click it to watch
• Breaches set roofs alight
• If the walls hold, home heroes sally at the leader
What wins: walls, towers, the watch called, heroes home.

steps.title: Townsfolk taken
steps.text: Raiders who get through can carry townsfolk off to their camp. They are held for a few days: post a [b]Rescue[/b] on the camp, or clear it, and they come home. If the days run out they are lost, and the town remembers it.

steps.title: Fear
steps.text:
The fear alert counts the days until the town gives up and the campaign is lost.
• Break the menace they fear most
• Win a fight
• Fund the temples
Stone never burns; the Library can fireproof timber.

steps.title: Full to the doors
steps.text:
Taverns, shrines, baths, theatres, halls, libraries and the arena hold so many.
• Full: folk try the next one, or go home put out
• Select a building: how full, how many turned away
• Turned away: its houses grow slower
Open another nearby.

steps.title: Arm your heroes
steps.text:
The town hall's [b]Armory[/b]: give magic arms, armour and charms to heroes in town.
• They wear it now, count it as pay, like you more
• A [b]sending stone[/b]: word home without a caster
• Fill it: [b]loot terms[/b] on bounties, a [b]loot pact[/b], or buy offers
• Sell what nobody needs

steps.title: The alchemy bench
steps.text:
An [b]Apothecary[/b] holds an alchemy bench ([b]Armory[/b] → Alchemy).
• Pick two or three ingredients, [b]Brew[/b]
• Herbs from your beds, monster parts from cleared lairs
• Each lends a quality: mending, vigour, ember, rime, gloom, purity
• Reach a recipe and it's yours; miss and it spoils

steps.title: Potions on the shelf
steps.text:
Brews wait on the town's shelf.
• [b]Healing draughts[/b]: heroes take them out
• [b]Ward[/b]: harder to hit at its kind of lair
• [b]Fever-breaker[/b]: saves a townsperson
• [b]Sell[/b] the rest from the shelf

steps.title: Inspirations and breaks
steps.text:
Townsfolk have moods, shown over their heads.
• High for days: [b]inspired[/b] (a named blade, a feast, a bumper crop)
• Low for days: they [b]break[/b] (a bender, a brawl, leaving town)
• Mandate up, town fed and housed: more of the first

steps.title: Draw your walls
steps.text:
You draw where walls run. Pick a wall on the build bar:
• Drag for curves, click for corners; back to the first point to close
• It must ring the town hall, through no building
• Hills and slopes make it dearer: green is cheap, red dear
• Nothing is zoned under it
• Click the line to add gates (1 to 4)
• Masons start once it has a gate, as timber and stone allow

steps.title: The town broadsheet
steps.text:
Once big enough, a printer sells a weekly issue: [b]Ledger[/b] → [b]Broadsheet[/b].
Pay for the next front page:
• [b]Praise the mayor[/b]: approval, can be found out
• [b]Cry up a hero[/b]: the selected hero
• [b]Name the guilds[/b]: secret societies under scrutiny
Heroes judge it.

steps.title: Fame and infamy
steps.text:
Heroes and companies make names.
• [b]Renown[/b]: ruins cleared, villages helped, walls held; the famous get epithets
• [b]Infamy[/b]: brawls, theft, desertion, treachery
• Famous: draw heroes, scare foes, cost more, courted elsewhere
• Notorious: never knighted; their past catches up

steps.title: Monuments that grow
steps.text:
The town hall, temple and keep grow by parts: a bell tower, a nave, a great hall.
• Click the building to see parts, gains and costs
• [b]Add[/b] one, or [b]Build it all now[/b] (can empty the treasury)
• [b]Grow on its own[/b]: the council adds parts from spare gold

steps.title: The turning year
steps.text:
The clock shows the season.
• Summer: visitors and war bands
• Autumn: the harvest fills the stores
• Winter: bare fields, snowed roads, hungry dead
Short [b]Winter stores[/b] (City)? Lay in grain before the snow.

steps.title: Law and strange bargains
steps.text:
Law and strange bargains:
• Hero brawls and thefts come to you: [b]pardon[/b], [b]fine[/b] or [b]jail[/b]
• Gifts from strangers carry debts due weeks later
• Dark gifts in dreams make heroes likelier to fall
• Beaten foes may beg quarter or join you

steps.title: Every ward has a voice
steps.text:
The wards judge your choices too.
• Market Ward: profit. Temple wardens: mercy. Wharf crews: free hands
• Choices show which wards they please or anger
• Warm wards grow sooner; sour ones grumble
See each ward in [b]City[/b].

steps.title: Petitions and hard choices
steps.text:
Townsfolk bring [b]petitions[/b]: a boundary stone, a muddy road, a watchman's widow.
• Some answers set a [b]decree[/b] for a while (tolls lifted, a curfew)
• Hard choices are remembered, and later stories turn on them
[b]Mayor[/b] shows decrees and memories.

steps.title: Minor powers
steps.text:
[b]Minor powers[/b]: smugglers, assassins, spies, lords, wizards, a dragon, a coven. Each has a leader, a goal and a price. In [b]Diplomacy[/b]:
• [b]Send gifts[/b]: raise standing
• [b]Ally[/b]: their price and a daily tithe
• [b]Break[/b] with one
• Enemy envoys court them too: outbid with gifts

steps.title: Envoys
steps.text:
A minor power has sent an [b]envoy[/b]. Answer in [b]Diplomacy[/b] before they ride home.
• Friendly: a cheap [b]alliance[/b]
• Cordial: a [b]truce[/b] no enemy can buy
• Hostile: [b]tribute[/b], remembered if refused
Each power joining an enemy draws the next.

steps.title: Heroes on guard
steps.text:
Keep heroes home to guard the town. In the [b]Defence[/b] tab, or on a hero's sheet:
• [b]Walls[/b]: stronger against raids and sieges; they meet the warlord first.
• [b]Streets[/b]: the watch catches more spies, knives, thieves and fire-raisers.
They earn a daily wage and take no bounties. [b]Arm the guard[/b] hands them the armory's best in one click.

steps.title: Sellswords
steps.text:
[b]Sellswords[/b] in [b]War[/b]: hire a company for a fee and daily wage.
• They stand on the walls with the watch
• Fund a campaign against a known menace's holds or seat
• Only heroes end the greatest foe
• Unpaid, they walk

steps.title: Cobbled streets
steps.text:
From the town charter, masons pave on their own:
• The square first, then outward
• As the market has stone and the treasury gold
• Cobbled streets: happier families
Keep a quarry working.

steps.title: Favours and feuds
steps.text:
Minor powers ask [b]favours[/b]: clear a lair, kill a foe, open a route.
• [b]Promise[/b]: three months; keep it for gold and friendship
• Break it: they remember
• [b]Feuds[/b]: their foe holds your alliance against you
• Pay your ally to win it and the foe sues for peace

steps.title: First contact
steps.text:
Powers and peoples stay unknown until you meet them. When one comes calling, a [b]first contact[/b] scene opens: your answers and rolls set where you start.

• The bar under each name in [b]Diplomacy[/b] shows where they stand
• Unmet ones can't trade, ally or be courted by you

steps.title: Bigger caravans
steps.text:
Surplus goods earn nothing sitting in the market.
• A [b]trade route[/b] turns them into gold
• [b]Add a wagon[/b] in [b]Diplomacy[/b]: more each run, up to four
• Bigger charters run more routes

steps.title: Clockwork wardens
steps.text:
A city with a mage tower or guildhall can build [b]clockwork wardens[/b] ([b]Defence[/b]).
• Never sleep, can't be bribed: catch agents
• Townsfolk dislike being watched by brass
• Thieves may try to steal one; a mage tower guards the keys

steps.title: Level up
steps.text:
Stories give you XP. Each level on [b]Mayor[/b]:
• Learn a skill, or become expert in one
• Levels 4 and 8: raise abilities or take a feat
Your sheet rolls on motions, demands, envoys and haggling.

steps.title: Diplomacy and trade
steps.text:
Villages, holds, enclaves, ports and oasis cities live in the wilds. [b]Diplomacy[/b]:
• See what each thinks of you
• [b]Envoy[/b] with gifts to win them
• Then a [b]trade route[/b]: sell surplus, buy what's short
• Each caravan warms them; at 60 they ally

steps.title: Merchant of the skies
steps.text:
The [b]Sky Dock[/b]'s airship trades too ([b]Diplomacy[/b] → [b]The airship[/b]).
• Pick a people and a spare good, [b]send[/b]
• Flies straight over rivers and peaks, twice as fast, no route needed
• Prices: more far out and for wants; less if sold lately
• Back with gold and their cheap goods
• Trading or carrying a company, not both

steps.title: Neighbours with lives of their own
steps.text:
Every settlement has a leader, a band and troubles. In [b]Diplomacy[/b]:
• Send [b]aid[/b] for a need
• Fund a [b]project[/b]: watchtower, bridge, waystation
• They remember: favours, and relief when a host marches on you

steps.title: A village in shadow
steps.text:
A risen enemy casts a [b]shadow[/b] on nearby settlements:
• Dread, then [b]tribute[/b] (no trade, families flee to you), then a puppet
• Darkened on the campaign map
Win them back in [b]Diplomacy[/b]: [b]rally[/b] with a hero, an envoy, or a bounty nearby.

steps.title: What villains are planning
steps.text:
A named menace is always plotting: a road, tithe-takers, a raid.
• Scrying its seat, or a nearby friend, reveals the plan
• [b]Campaign[/b] shows it and the holdings it rests on
• Clear a holding: the plan is set back
• Strong settlements turn plans away

steps.title: A demand for fealty
steps.text: Some enemies want your town kneeling, not burning. When their heralds come, open [b]Campaign[/b]: [b]Bend the knee[/b] and pay tribute while their raiders stay away, or [b]Refuse[/b] and face their host. Silence counts as a refusal.

steps.title: End-game crises
steps.text:
A power left alone late starts its [b]crisis[/b]: the Great Horde, the Long Dark, Wyrmfire...
• Burns houses, knifes councillors, fouls stores
• Ends with its host at the gates
• Break its seat first and it dies
• Several feed each other
[b]Campaign[/b]: ride out when two crises clash.

steps.title: A traitor on the council
steps.text:
A clever enemy may turn a councillor.
• They vote against you, skim the treasury, slander you
• When names are named, [b]Council[/b] shows two suspects
• Name the traitor: they flee. Wrong: an honest one resigns
• Wait: the watch finds proof in time

steps.title: Councillors' secrets
steps.text:
Most councillors hide something.
• [b]Dig[/b] by a seat: an Investigation roll (watchmen help)
• Botched: they hear you asked
• [b]Press[/b]: their vote your way, once
• [b]Expose[/b]: they lose the seat
Either way they won't forgive you.

steps.title: The trade guilds
steps.text:
Workers in one trade formed a [b]guild[/b]; its master leans on a councillor.
• Demands come with a deadline (taxes, a festival, land)
• [b]Meet it[/b]: they warm to you
• [b]Pay them off[/b]: it goes away
• Ignored: they sour, then [b]strike[/b]
• [b]Break the strike[/b] with the watch: costs Mandate
• Its master is a [b]Notable[/b]: win them over and the guild warms too

steps.title: The movement and the mages
steps.text:
[b]The Common Cause[/b]: workers, and some hedge mages, want magic to serve the trades. The bar in [b]Council[/b]:
• Research and hedge mages pull it to the mages
• Numbers and guilds pull it back
• Keep it green: both work together
• Too far: marches and strikes, or mages walk out
• [b]Hear[/b] a side for gold, or [b]side[/b] with one a season

steps.title: Honours are yours to give
steps.text:
An alert says when a loyal knight has no land or the town no champion.
• Click it: grant a cleared site to the knight
• They hold it with retainers and live on its rents
• The champion stands first on the walls
Sign knighthoods in [b]Council[/b].

steps.title: Heroes and their callings
steps.text:
Each class brings its own stories: a bard's stage, a paladin's oath, a warlock's patron.
• Some answers give a [b]calling[/b]: a lasting daily part in town
• Kept while the hero stays loyal
[b]Mayor[/b] lists callings; a hero's card shows theirs.

steps.title: The hall of heroes
steps.text:
A hero fell in the town's service: see the [b]hall of heroes[/b] in [b]Chronicles[/b].
• Raise a [b]memorial[/b]: every hero a little more loyal
• Kin may come with their best magic item
• Retired heroes train new ones

steps.title: A bastion of their own
steps.text:
A famous company asks for land on the edge of town for a [b]bastion[/b].
• A keep with facilities: garden, drill yard, smithy
• Hires townsfolk; sentries in a siege; heroes stay loyal
Answer in [b]Companies[/b]: grant, give free or refuse.

steps.title: Under the streets
steps.text:
Digging broke into the [b]undercity[/b]; each charter opens a deeper level.
• Left alone it [b]stirs[/b], until something comes up at night
• [b]City[/b]: send the watch on [b]patrol[/b] for a little gold
• Or a bounty: heroes delve with no road
• Cleared: quiet for a season

steps.title: The library and its scholars
steps.text:
Your scholars can study something new. Open [b]Library[/b].
• Ideas appear from your town and the world: newcomers, trade, buildings, books, explorers' finds, monsters your companies slay
• Pick one to [b]study[/b]: scholars, books, mages and finds move it, gold can't buy it
• [b]Funding[/b] only speeds them a little

steps.title: The summer tourney
steps.text:
Each summer from village charter, the council proposes a tourney: Joust, Archery, Wizards' Duel, Race.
• Click its alert: fund it modest, grand or legendary, or skip
• Heroes ride against neighbours' champions
• Stake gold on a rider before the first heat
• Winners earn renown; crowds spend in town

steps.title: Grand works
steps.text:
A rich town raises grand works: clock tower, aqueduct, mage tower... and wonders in a great city.
• Over 15,000 gold in the treasury costs upkeep: build
• [b]City[/b] → [b]Grand works[/b], place it like a government building
• Rises over seasons, a stage at a time
• Helps the whole town for good

steps.title: The town's institutions
steps.text:
Each [b]institution[/b] has a keeper, a daily service and requests now and then.
• Make its choice
• Fund it: generous buys more service and goodwill
• Answer its keeper, or they sour

steps.title: On the road
steps.text:
Each hero on the road takes a job and rolls for it:
• [b]Navigate[/b]: lost costs hours
• [b]Forage[/b]: hungry heroes fight worse
• [b]Track[/b]: a back way in
• [b]Watch[/b] and [b]treat wounds[/b] at night
Everyday jobs never fail; avalanches and sandstorms can. Watch for wells, dead-magic ground, ferrymen, oases and old gateways.

steps.title: Institutions to discover
steps.text:
The town starts knowing none of its [b]institutions[/b].
They come to light from
• heroes and folk who settle
• crafts and trade
• sites cleared
• a bigger charter
Heard-of ones show what they still need, then rise from the Government build bar.

steps.title: Your fleet
steps.text:
Your harbour's boats:
• [b]Fish[/b] while moored
• [b]Sail[/b] trade runs down the coast (Diplomacy)
• [b]Wear[/b] at sea: patch them at the quay
• Meet [b]corsairs[/b]: captains grow from green to legendary
Build longships and carracks as the town grows.

steps.title: Your airships
steps.text:
The Sky Dock's ships:
• [b]Lift-crystal[/b]: charge it at the dock; run dry and the ship comes down
• [b]Patrol[/b]: raiders seen sooner
• [b]Scout[/b] a land, or [b]strike[/b] a lair before a company goes in
• Fights: approach, ballistae, then boarding: take heroes as marines
• Downed ships: send riggers to [b]salvage[/b] them

steps.title: Tales at the tavern
steps.text:
A delve worth telling comes home as a tale: a card, room by room, with the heroes' words and dice.
• [b]Skip[/b]: to the big moment
• [b]Hear the tale[/b] on any chronicle in the Ledger
• Loading and each season open with a recap ([b]Enter[/b] carries on)

steps.title: New wards
steps.text:
A new charter opens land round the old town.
• Wards aren't drawn: a quarter becomes one from what's built
• Shops: Market Ward. Workshops: Trades. Shrines: Temple. Fine houses: Castle Hill
See them in [b]City[/b].

steps.title: Build tall
steps.text:
Town charter: [b]medium density[/b]; large town: [b]high[/b].
• Paint [b]Res · Medium[/b] / [b]High[/b] (or Commercial), even over built streets
• Houses grow to stone townhouses, then tall houses
• Dearer land, a little crowded: let sprawl spread outside

steps.title: Ruins to restore
steps.text:
Some lairs are ruins of old works: aqueduct, gatehouse, watchtower, star fort.
• Cleared: an alert says it can be restored
• Click it or open [b]Campaign[/b], [b]Restore[/b]
• For a little gold: water, defence or early warning

steps.title: Rope bridges
steps.text:
Rope bridges cross gorges on the roads.
• Raiders may cut one: companies go the long way
• [b]Campaign[/b] → [b]Rebuild in stone[/b]
• Stone can't be cut

steps.title: The law book
steps.text:
The [b]law book[/b] in [b]Council[/b] sets what happens when the watch catches a hero.
• Fine: the old way
• Stocks, flogging: calmer streets, fewer repeats; the temple frowns
• Temple penance: priests pleased, guilds call it soft
• Restitution: guilds pleased, purses emptied

steps.title: The council chamber
steps.text:
[b]Council[/b] opens on the chamber, your councillors at their seats.
• Raised hand: aye. Thumbs down: nay.
• Heart on the plate: loyalty.
• Badges over heads: who moved it, secrets you hold, traitor talk.
• Click a councillor for their card.

steps.title: Who can ride
steps.text:
The [b]Bounty board[/b] opens on who is free to ride today.
• Each threat has a coloured pill per company: green easy, red deadly, for those heroes
• Click a pill to offer that company the job by name
• Hover any button to see what it costs and does

steps.title: Watchtowers
steps.text:
Build a [b]Watchtower[/b] (Government) to see the wilds live.
• Sees farther as the town grows
• One per 100 residents
• Past its sight, the fog stays

steps.title: Notices
steps.text:
Something new for you? A tile slides out beside its window.
• Click: go there
• Right-click: tuck it away
• Red: urgent · Gold: your call

steps.title: Scry the fight
steps.text:
A party that sent word is fighting out of sight: an alert offers a [b]scry[/b].
• Each caster scries once every 2 days
• Loyal casters: free
• Others: gold
• Disaffected: a favour

steps.title: The army
steps.text:
[b]Army[/b] raises the town's own soldiers.
• Build a [b]Drill Yard[/b], [b]Archery Range[/b] or [b]Stables[/b] (Government)
• Raise a regiment: townsfolk leave their trades, are armed and drill
• Post it: walls, reserve, patrol or the mayor's guard
• Put a hero in command to lead it

steps.title: The levy
steps.text:
When a host comes, call the [b]levy[/b] in [b]Army[/b].
• Townsfolk leave their work while called
• Laws: volunteers or conscription, paid or unpaid
• Conscripts and the unpaid grumble

steps.title: Calling allies
steps.text:
Allies send hosts when you [b]call[/b] them in [b]Army[/b].
• Answers come within the day
• Holdouts: pay, negotiate or let go
• Hosts march the road: call early
• A friend under a shadow may turn at the walls

steps.title: Marching out
steps.text:
Meet a host on the road before it reaches the walls: the [b]Field[/b] card in [b]Army[/b].
• Pick who marches; the rest hold the walls
• Give heroes a goal: the leader, the banner
• Pick an order: the dice and your commanders do the rest

steps.title: Marching on others
steps.text:
[b]Army[/b] can march on any settlement you have met.
• Every people sees it: allies trust you less
• Won: occupy, pillage, cripple or spare
• Held towns pay tribute, resist and may rise
• Leave a regiment there to hold it down

steps.title: Roads to victory
steps.text:
[b]Campaign[/b] lists every way to win.
• Slay the big bad, or
• Allies, dominion, legends, a golden age, adventurers, trade
• Once the big bad shows itself and a road's terms all hold: [b]Claim[/b]
• It marches at once. Hold the terms to win

steps.title: Getting about
steps.text:
• [b]Ctrl[/b]+1–0 pins what's selected; [b]1[/b]–[b]0[/b] flies back
• [b]F[/b] follows who's selected
• [b]Alt[/b]+Left or mouse back: where you were
• [b]F11[/b] fullscreen · every key in Settings › Keys

steps.title: Change your mind
steps.text:
• [b]Ctrl[/b]+[b]Z[/b] takes back your last brush stroke
• A site's card: [b]Call off[/b], all gold back if not begun
• A building's card: [b]Tear down[/b] for a little back

steps.title: Hand it to a steward
steps.text:
Settings › [b]Stewards[/b]: for each area of business
• [b]You[/b] handle it
• A [b]steward[/b] does
• Or the steward [b]asks you[/b]: a small ✔ / ✖ card, hover for why

steps.title: Keep it clear
steps.text:
A cleared site won't stay clear: something moves back in.
• [b]Patrol it[/b] from its card: a little gold a day
• Your best hero at home drives off newcomers
• A failed patrol can wound the hero
• Later, build a tower to hold it for good

steps.title: A tower tested
steps.text:
Something is coming to test one of your towers.
• [b]Reinforce[/b] it from its card before they come
• A strong garrison holds
• A weak one falls, and the site wants clearing again

steps.title: Your regalia
steps.text:
[b]Mayor[/b] (C) shows your six regalia slots:
• Circlet · Chain · Signet · Sceptre · Mantle · Banner
• [b]Wear[/b] pieces from the armory
• [b]Commission[/b] new ones as the charter grows
• Rare ones from the wilds ward off knives, lies and charms
They lift your rolls, Mandate and the council, and win heroes over. A banner goes with every company that marches.

steps.title: Where your mayor goes
steps.text:
Your mayor is a person in the town, with hit points. In [b]Mayor[/b] pick their days:
• [b]Stay in the hall[/b]: safe
• [b]Walk the streets[/b]: Mandate and loyalty, but knives and breaches reach you
• [b]Ride with a company[/b]: an edge for the company and XP, and its dangers

steps.title: Your mayor is dead
steps.text:
In [b]Mayor[/b]:
• [b]Raise[/b] them at the temple, if the body came home and you can pay
• Or [b]name a new mayor[/b] from the council's three
Wait too long and the council chooses. Mandate falls every day without a mayor.

steps.title: Skywright relics
steps.text:
A company brought home a [b]Skywright relic[/b].
• Five lie at the far edges of the map
• Each sparks high magic in the Library
• All five open the [b]Lofted City[/b]
• Foes race you for them: break a foe to take back what it stole

steps.title: The Lofted City
steps.text:
Your [b]Lofted City[/b] flies.
• [b]Sail[/b] it from the Library to any land you know
• Companies set out from under it
• It sees every site below

steps.title: The year's omen
steps.text:
Each year the seers foretell one omen for a season.
• See it under the season in the [b]City[/b] window
• Green helps, red hurts
• Plan stores and walls round it

steps.title: Word on the roads
steps.text:
Heroes rate the town out of five stars: beds, pay, gear, healing, welcome.
• Good word brings more heroes, and better ones
• See the stars and their says in [b]Companies[/b]

steps.title: Lasting wounds
steps.text:
A hero who goes down in a fight may come home with a lasting wound.
• Click the hero to see what it costs them
• Mend it at the shrine, the temple, or with clockwork

steps.title: Wall traps
steps.text:
Click a stretch of wall to lay traps before it.
• Each takes a share of every wave there
• Pitch burns once: refill it from [b]Defence[/b]
• Fliers pass over

steps.title: Sickness
steps.text:
Sickness only comes when something brings it: the dead, rats, a caravan.
• It spreads house to house
• Send the healers, or close the sick lanes, from the [b]City[/b] window

steps.title: The dark company
steps.text:
The big bad has its own adventurers: they fetch what its quests seek and rob hoards.
• Whoever reaches a site first takes it
• Or ambush them on the road from [b]Campaign[/b]
• Beaten, their leader may join you

steps.title: The whole campaign
steps.text:
The [b]Chronicles[/b] window draws the town's people, gold, dread and more since day one.
• Pins mark sieges, charters and the fallen
• Hover a pin for what happened

steps.title: Notable townsfolk
steps.text:
People worth knowing rise in town: the best smith, a merchant prince, the innkeeper, a wizard in a tower. Open [b]Notables[/b].
• Visit: a skill check they like
• Gifts and favours warm them
• Warm: they pass on news
• Some favours are quests: their gold on the board for a company
• Friends: boons
• Bitter: they walk away

steps.title: Swaying the vote
steps.text:
Each councillor rolls a [b]d20[/b] + their lean to vote. Hover a vote to see it.
• Before you sign, [b]Sway[/b] one councillor
• Persuade, Intimidate or Deceive: each shows its odds
• A loyal councillor trained in the skill helps: advantage
• One try a motion

steps.title: Negotiating
steps.text:
[b]Negotiate[/b] with a guild or a holding-out ally.
• Choose how: Persuade, Intimidate or Deceive
• Each shows the d20, its DC and your odds
• Win: settled without gold. Lose: they think less of you
• One try each demand

steps.title: The court
steps.text:
Heroes the watch catches now stand [b]trial[/b]. No dice.
• The case: your captain's Investigation, the watch, witnesses
• Against their tale: their Deception
• Guilty: the law book's sentence. Not: they walk free
• From a Town, a caster of [b]Zone of Truth[/b] lets no lie stand

steps.title: Conditions
steps.text:
People can be [b]Exhausted[/b], [b]Frightened[/b], [b]Charmed[/b], [b]Sick[/b], [b]Wounded[/b] or [b]Inspired[/b].
• Shown on their card as icons
• Inspired: advantage on their rolls
• The rest: disadvantage
• Hover one for what it does

steps.title: Painted patrols
steps.text:
Press [b]Patrol[/b] over the corner map and paint the wilds.
• Riders keep it for a daily wage
• Roads through it lose fewer caravans
• Raiders crossing it are seen sooner
• Send outriders or knights from [b]Bounties[/b] to save the wage

steps.title: Re-arm the army
steps.text:
Each regiment in [b]Army[/b] can be re-armed by the town's smiths.
• Steel, then masterwork, then runed arms
• Each grade makes every soldier stronger
• Needs a [b]Forge[/b] with smiths at work
• Paid soldier by soldier as they are armed

steps.title: Buy them out
steps.text:
A rich town can buy what it can't build.
• A shop or workshop: select it, [b]Buy for the town[/b]
• A people's charter in [b]Diplomacy[/b]: they swear to you
• An ally's oath: no tithe, and no enemy can buy it
• Owners and peoples who don't trust you won't sell

steps.title: Renown
steps.text:
Companies keep their members and earn [b]renown[/b] for every deed.
• Each bounty row shows the renown it suggests
• Short of it, more foes stand and fight
• A company's new step of fame lifts your Mandate
• Newcomers join the most renowned company with room

steps.title: Your own company
steps.text:
Pick a company in [b]Companies[/b] and [b]Retain for good[/b].
• Costlier with more levels and renown
• Then a daily wage
• They lean to every job you offer
• Their reports come home free
• They never leave, unless the wage stops

steps.title: Magic that does things
steps.text:
Magic items have [b]powers[/b] now.
• Fireballs, chain lightning, holds, healing
• A whisper home, a glass that scries for you
• Hover an item for its powers
• Heroes wear up to 3 charms; some suit one class

steps.title: Parts and the forge
steps.text:
Companies bring home [b]parts[/b] from what they beat: wolf fangs, troll blood, drake scales.
• [b]Armory[/b]: sell them, or have the forge make arms
• Plain +1/+2/+3 arms: dearer and finer parts as they rise
• Strong foes carry their own magic: a frost giant its gauntlets

steps.title: Arm the watch
steps.text:
Plain +1/+2/+3 arms can go to the [b]watch[/b] and your [b]regiments[/b].
• [b]Armory[/b]: Arm or Recall each unit
• Each piece makes the unit stronger
• Heroes take them too, until real magic beats them

steps.title: Relics in the hall
steps.text:
Big finds go to the [b]town hall[/b] and work from there.
• A caravan bell: fewer caravans waylaid
• A warlord's tusk: more defence on the walls
• [b]Armory[/b]: see what each relic does

steps.title: The open sea
steps.text:
Word of the open sea has reached town.
• Islands, wrecks and sea caves lie out there
• Companies sail to them like any other site
• A great island city trades and grows
• Corsairs, reef folk and a drowned cult hold the water

steps.title: The final host
steps.text:
The big bad's host [b]gathers[/b] at its seat and holdings before it marches.
• No countdown: only word from your eyes
• A tower, patrol, scout or scrying by a camp counts it
• A fight at a camp thins it; a cleared holding scatters it
• Meet it on the road with the army

steps.title: Six groups, tabs inside
steps.text:
The rail holds six groups: [b]Town[/b], [b]Council[/b], [b]Heroes[/b], [b]War[/b], [b]Realm[/b], [b]Lore[/b].
• Each window's tabs run along its top, with their own badges
• Long windows split into pages
• Click a heading to fold it; it stays folded

steps.title: Every faction has its ways
steps.text:
Each people, power and foe has its own [b]manners[/b]: proud, greedy, shy, fierce...
• A first meeting plays out by them
• They make rolls against them easier or harder
• [b]Overtures[/b] in Diplomacy win them their way

steps.title: Build by kind
steps.text:
The build bar sorts by kind: [b]Homes[/b], [b]Farming[/b], [b]Industry[/b], [b]Trade[/b], [b]Leisure[/b], [b]Faith[/b], [b]Civic[/b], [b]Defence[/b].
• Paint zones first, then place buildings
• A kind shows once you can build any of it
• Buildings far past your charter stay hidden

steps.title: Kit out a company
steps.text:
[b]Heroes[/b] → [b]Companies[/b]: click a company in the roster.
• [b]Party[/b]: click a face to open their sheet
• [b]Give[/b]: pick an armory item and who gets it
• [b]Arm all[/b]: the best gear to each
• [b]Purse[/b]: gold for loyalty
• Each sheet has its own [b]Give[/b] too

steps.title: Ships at sea
steps.text:
The harbour's ships sail more than trade runs.
• Companies bound for islands board a free ship
• [b]Patrol[/b] the home waters: fewer corsair raids
• [b]Scout[/b] a sea land, or [b]bombard[/b] a sea site first
• Heroes, the watch or hired marines stand at the rail

steps.title: Overdue
steps.text:
A company long gone with no word is [b]overdue[/b].
• All you know: where it went and when it was due
• Send a stone or scry the site for word
• High isles, the cloud sea and dragon roosts need an airship that climbs high enough
• Lost up there? [b]Bounties[/b]: send an airship to look

steps.title: Lift-crystal
steps.text:
Airships burn [b]lift-crystal[/b]: a day of it for each day aloft.
• Traders at the Sky Dock sell a little a month, dear
• Companies bring shards home from the sky
• High isles show seams: [b]mine[/b] them
• Discoveries make it go further

steps.title: From the air
steps.text:
Something in the sky is coming for the town.
• Walls are no help
• Moored airships, watchtowers, the watch and heroes at home fight it
• Clear its isle first and it never comes
• A Signal Tower at the Sky Dock warns sooner

steps.title: Peoples of the sky
steps.text:
Some neighbours live above the clouds: the cloud court, griffon clans, a rare ancient dragon.
• Envoys, trade and war need an airship that climbs to them
• Allied griffon clans sell griffons
• The Sky Dock grows masts and add-ons

steps.title: The harbour grows
steps.text:
The [b]Harbour[/b] grows like a monument: click it.
• Quays berth more ships; extra ships wait at anchor and land less cargo
• Shipyard: cheaper ships
• Trading house: dearer sales
• Lighthouse, naval barracks, dry dock

steps.title: Ferries
steps.text:
The great river runs from the mountains to the sea, crossed only at fords and bridges.
• Put a [b]ferry[/b] over a long reach: [b]Campaign[/b], Roads
• Everyone may use it, foes too
• Cut it to hold the river; raiders cut it too

steps.title: Rooms and the road
steps.text:
Newcomers come up the road and stay a few nights first.
• Work, a home or land: they settle
• Nothing: they move on, and the Ledger says why
• No room at an inn: they camp
• Heroes camp too, take bounties, then ride on after 3 nights
• Taverns let 4 rooms, an [b]Inn[/b] 12: commission one from the Build bar

steps.title: Refugees
steps.text:
Folk fleeing burned or raided villages camp by the road.
• They work, buy and build at once
• They wait while homes and work go up
• A big column asks you first: take them, some, or none
• Sheltering them earns Mandate, thanks and a name
• They post a plea to retake their home: clear it, and those still camped go home and rebuild
• Settled ones stay for good

steps.title: Walls, gate and fields
steps.text:
[b]Defence[/b] → Guard: the wall, the gate and the fields.
• Fields inside the walls yield half: farm outside
• Raiders strip fields no [b]guard flag[/b] stands over
• A wall wants a watchman every 12 paces at night
• Gate law: [b]Open[/b], [b]Watched[/b] or [b]Shut[/b]
• Watched and shut turn away footpads and spies, but fewer settlers come

steps.title: The last ride
steps.text:
Your champions are strong enough to face the big bad.
• [b]War[/b] → [b]Ride[/b] sends them for its seat
• No company goes there on its own: the call is yours
• Its host always marches in the end: meet it at the walls or on the road

steps.title: Towers and barracks on the wall
steps.text:
Towers and wall barracks go where you put them.
• Pick one on the build bar or in [b]Defence[/b] → Walls
• Click a stretch of the wall
• One of each to a stretch
• Towers watch and shoot; barracks house the watch

steps.title: A rare find
steps.text:
Heroes brought home a [b]rare[/b] or finer magic item.
• The tile wears its rarity: [color=#5b8fe0]rare[/color], [color=#a86ae0]very rare[/color], [color=#e09a3a]legendary[/color], [color=#e0503a]artifact[/color]
• [b]Click[/b] it: the hero who carries it, or its card in the [b]Armory[/b]
• Nobody can use it? Give it to a hero who can
